summary.headline: Astrolabes and Rhetorius’ Zodiacal Doctrine
summary.text: Catalog entries for Milanese codices 34 and 35, including Nicephorus Gregoras on constructing an astrolabe and its tympana, and Rhetorius’ exposition of zodiacal doctrine from Antiochus’ treasures. Topics include zodiacal gender and mixtures, exaltations and depressions, oppositions, trigon lords, decans, aspects, radiation, spear-bearing, lots, and house divisions.
